artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: baseline, atomic lakefile.toml migration (package renamed BimodalLogic) with shared tomllib scraper, docs.yml rewrite/re-enable, prose updates, user-authorized Pages enable + push + green-run verification.

user_decision.question: Phase 5 must push local main (about 148 commits ahead of origin) and enable a public GitHub Pages site (source = GitHub Actions) to verify the docs workflow. Authorize both when implementation reaches that phase?
options: Authorize push to main and Pages enablement in Phase 5
Defer: stop after Phase 4 and push/enable Pages manually later
user_decision.recommended: Authorize push to main and Pages enablement in Phase 5
